summary: Forward chat completions and apply trims
description: Add the OpenAI-compatible gateway. FR-C1-01 and FR-C1-04. create_gateway forwards to an injected httpx client and replaces messages when decide returns trim.
scope: Non-streaming JSON is forwarded and the upstream JSON is returned
Trimmed messages are what the upstream receives
acceptanceCriteria: A short user message returns the upstream assistant content ok and the upstream request contains that user content. A tool message with token_count 4001 is forwarded with the trim marker, while the latest user content stays LATEST. FR-C1-01 FR-C1-04.
constraints: Do not call a real network host. Use the injected httpx.Client only.
Do not trim the latest user message.
Do not require a live Ollama process.
